note: Gzipped bytes, checked by scripts/check-bundle-size.ts. The JS figure is almost entirely the compiled catalog, so it grows with every entry added. Raising a limit is a deliberate change: say in the commit what grew and why the download cost is worth it. Every asset kind the build emits must appear in gzipBytes or in unbudgeted (a kind name mapped to the reason it is waived); anything else fails the check rather than passing unnoticed. totalGzipBytes is the sum of the per-kind limits, so a new kind cannot be paid for out of another kind's headroom.
